title: The reconstruction
lead: What has to be done to the house, and the work that has already started.
paragraphs: The family is surveying the work with people from the town.
Before a wall can go up, the house has to be emptied. That is what is happening now.

photoEssay.heading: The first job was to get the rubble out
photoEssay.note: Before a wall can go up, the house has to be emptied. That is what is happening now, with people from the town and a borrowed machine.

photos.alt: A man with a shovel piles rubble into a mound of broken brick and ash. Behind him, the bucket of a yellow loader is already full of burned remains.
photos.caption: The rubble is cleared by hand and loaded by machine.

photos.alt: Burned engine parts laid on the floor and on a table, sorted by type: pipes, exhaust manifolds, a blue crate of tools. The legs of several people working around them are visible.
photos.caption: What can be salvaged from the workshop is sorted piece by piece.
